name: list_photo_specs
description: The passport, visa, ID card and other ID photo specs fotosize has checked against official sources, with an id for get_photo_spec. Filter by country code.

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: Country code: us, uk, es, mx, br, jp, de, nl, tr, vn, id, in, lat, kr

name: get_photo_spec
description: One ID photo spec: print size in mm, head size, allowed backgrounds, online pixel size and file limit, who takes the photo, the official source and check date, and a link to make the photo.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.desc: Language of the linked page, default en
